name: gurado WebConnect – Gift Card & Voucher Shop for WordPress
author: gurado

sections.description:
Sell gift cards and vouchers online and in-store – no commissions, no delays, fully in your design.

gurado WebConnect lets you start selling digital gift cards and vouchers directly on your own website — in just a few minutes.
Your customers buy online, pay through your own payment provider, and receive their gift card instantly by email (PDF) or directly in Apple Wallet or Google Wallet.
You receive the money immediately into your own account – gurado takes no commission per transaction.

Whether you run a restaurant, hotel, spa, or retail shop, gurado helps you launch a fully branded gift card shop that works seamlessly across all your sales channels.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ and activate it.
  2. In the editor, insert the block “gurado WebConnect”.
  3. Fill shop (required) and optional attributes.
  4. For Classic Editor use the shortcode:
    [gurado_widget shop=”my-shop” mode=”bubble” page=”” align=”right” offsetX=”1rem” offsetY=”8px”]
sections.faq:
The widget does not render

Ensure shop is set and the vendor script is reachable over HTTPS.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Initial public release with block + shortcode and i18n support.
